title: High Tide CEO Discusses Q3 Guidance on The Dales Report
summary: Raj Grover, Founder and CEO of High Tide, joined The Dales Report to discuss the Company’s preliminary third quarter 2026 guidance, including expected record revenue, gross profit and Adjusted EBITDA.
